keyPhrases.text: try-hard set dressing clogging up Circle in the Square
enervating effect of so aggressively clickbaity and uncurious a production
surface is all there is — indifferent dignity with a heavy glaze of alikeness
work I have both loved and loathed

reasoning: This is a scathing pan that systematically dismantles the production. The critic calls it 'nothing,' 'enervating,' 'clickbaity and uncurious,' lacking coherence, and suggests it makes Romeo and Juliet seem 'mid.' The tone is deeply dismissive throughout with harsh, intellectual criticism and no meaningful praise.
